description: Fetch the curated daily agentic-web news and adoption digest for a YYYY-MM-DD date (defaults to latest). Returns the stored digest plus latest_date and days_old (whole UTC days behind the newest digest; 0 when this date is the latest). Pass list: true to return { latest, latest_date, days_old: null, count, digests, page }, or compact: true (alias: include_stats: false) to omit the stats block. Use digest for daily narrative summaries; use changes for raw field-level diffs.
name: digest
title: Agentic web daily digest
